decisions.reason: Limiting HubSpot reporting to a basic sales funnel does not change the configured lead-management properties, stages, lists, notes, or task-assignment behavior.
The reporting-scope clarification does not change whether email and LinkedIn communication histories are visible in HubSpot.
The source narrows the required reports but does not change the HubSpot platform, subscription plan, or general CRM use.
A basic sales-funnel reporting scope does not alter synchronization of MeetAlfred reply statuses into HubSpot.
The clarification concerns HubSpot reports and does not change list transfer or contact-import behavior between HubSpot and MeetAlfred.
The reporting clarification neither resumes nor changes the deferred automated email campaign.
The scope of HubSpot reporting does not change the automated LinkedIn campaign's channel, mode, or platform.
The basic sales-funnel report does not alter the selection or export of LinkedIn prospects to Apollo.
The HubSpot reporting scope does not change MeetAlfred configuration or its subscription plan.
The clarification of required reporting does not change the Sales Navigator source-list requirement.
The basic sales-funnel reporting requirement does not alter Zapier configuration, subscription tier, or add-on requirements.
The reporting-scope change does not modify Apollo-to-HubSpot contact transfer behavior or expected transfer latency.
